expected_output.reasoning:
The response delivers a six-section resilience report in order (1. Scenario and scope, 2. Targets, 3. Strategy, 4. Roadmap, 5. First tests, 6. Next decision), matching the expected structure. It explicitly flags the ECS service running a single task in a single AZ/subnet ('a single ECS task pinned to one subnet in one AZ', 'the ECS service only runs in eu-central-1a'). It notes the absence of a load balancer and failover routing ('no load balancer, no API Gateway, and no internet gateway anywhere in the VPC', 'Add Route 53 (or similar) health-checked failover once an entry point and a recovery-region deployment both exist'). It discusses whether the CloudFormation stack dr-demo-backend could recreate the service in eu-west-1 ('CloudFormation stack dr-demo-backend | Not deployed anywhere in eu-west-1 | Deploy the network/compute shell into eu-west-1 ahead of time'). It proposes restore/rebuild tests (restore from eu-west-1 copy, stop single task test) and named AWS FIS tests (AZ: Power Interruption, Cross-Region: Connectivity). It explicitly avoids inventing RPO/RTO targets ('No RPO or RTO has been agreed yet, so I'm not going to invent one.'). All core expected elements are present and substantively correct.</reasoning>
